newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE white sugar ends down, but off lows.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE white sugar ends down, but off lows.

text.p: White sugar futures finished down but above the day's lows on Thursday as selling pressure persisted throughout the afternoon session.
Traders said losses were exacerbated by white sugar premium sales against the New York raw sugar contracts, while fund selling was also seen.
December ended $1.20 weaker at $327.50 a tonne, off the day's low of $327.00. March fell $1.60 to the day's nadir of $324.20. Total volume was a solid 2,859 lots traded.
Traders said they were still awaiting the result of Syria's tender to buy 13,000 tonnes of whites and 13,000 tonnes of raws for October and November.
In Paris December shed 50 cents to $327.50 and March slumped $2.00 to $325.00. Turnover was 319 lots.
